Karnataka Declares September 15 as Engineers' Day

Karnataka has declared September 15th as Engineers' Day, commencing from 2027. The state government will celebrate the day annually. Additionally, the government has permitted individuals to use the prefix 'Er.' before their names, signifying their engineering qualification. This decision was announced by Karnataka government officials.
